title: Explore Makati
productRole: City orientation layer that connects durable places and experiences to BetterMakati's canonical places, areas, barangays, heritage, history, mobility and current activity.

complete.capability: Current source reconciliation for the six starter experiences and two external resources
Civic Map, Areas, Barangays, Heritage, History, Mobility and What’s On cross-links
Explore-specific Search entries without duplicating canonical Place/Area/Barangay identities
Explore Makati naming aligned across navigation, footer and homepage
Volatile commercial discovery kept in live external/API search rather than canonical registries

bounded.capability: Comprehensive restaurants, cafés, bars, hotels, shops and mall-tenant directory
bounded.reason: These listings change quickly and are better handled through live discovery and first-party/operator sources.

bounded.capability: Hard-coded recurring market hours and temporary-location schedules
bounded.reason: Salcedo Saturday Market and Legazpi Sunday Market remain recurring experiences whose current operating details stay with live sources.

bounded.capability: Standalone canonical Greenbelt commercial-complex object in Explore Makati
bounded.reason: Ayala Center is the durable canonical orientation identity; Greenbelt remains a current external commercial-discovery handoff and is not conflated with Greenbelt Park.

bounded.capability: Parking discovery or parking facility registry
bounded.reason: Parking was explicitly removed from BetterMakati and remains outside Explore Makati.

deferred.capability: Fresh production deployment and live-browser verification of W5-6
deferred.reason: The latest Vercel deployment reports failure and current connector access cannot retrieve build logs for the BetterMakati deployment, so repository closure does not claim a successful fresh deployment or browser pass.
deferred.nonClaim: The failed deployment status without build-log evidence does not establish that W5-6 code caused the failure.

finalStatement: W5-6 Explore Makati is closed at repository level as a bounded city-orientation layer, with volatile commercial discovery externalized and fresh deployment/live-browser verification deferred.
